notes.title: Save The Kingdom DLC Launch
notes.content:
The fourth DLC for The Book Of Yorle is released (Save The Kingdom).

After the Church of the Holy Yorle has been restored you can travel to the castle of the kingdom. Explore the many floors of the castle. Watch out for what lies below. Find the source of the Evil Ones and put a stop to the destruction and mayhem they have caused.

Over 50 more pages are available to be added to your personalized Book Of Yorle story in the order you find them. With over 200 pages in total (if all released DLCs are owned), can you find them all to complete your book (so far)?

notes.title: Save The Countryside DLC Launch
notes.content:
The third DLC for The Book Of Yorle is released (Save The Countryside).

After the Church of the Holy Yorle has been restored you can travel out to the countryside. Visit the fishermen's cabins, stop in at the Twin Dragon Inn, explore the multiple cavern systems. Don't get lost in the largest known cavern system in the kingdom, the Volcano Cave. Try not to drown or get eaten by sharks in Dragon's Eye Lake. Modes of transportation (other than walking) become available.

Over 30 more pages are available to be added to your personalized Book Of Yorle story in the order you find them. With almost 150 pages in total (if all released DLCs are owned), can you find them all to complete your book (so far)?

notes.title: Save The Farmland DLC Launch
notes.content:
The second DLC for The Book Of Yorle is released (Save The Farmland).

After the Church of the Holy Yorle has been restored you can travel to the nearby farmland. Will you be able to navigate your way through the maze of corn to find your way to the barn and the farmhouse. Did a graveyard really pop up in the middle of the cornfield? What lies therein or below? Where did the fog enshrouding the farm and orchard come from? Will you be able to "Save The Farmland"? 

Over 30 more pages are available to be added to your personalized Book Of Yorle story in the order you find them. With over 100 pages in total (if all released DLCs are owned), can you find them all to complete your book (so far)?

notes.title: Save The Village DLC Launch
notes.content:
The first expansion for The Book Of Yorle is released ([b][i]Save The Village[/i][/b]). After saving the Church of the [b]Holy Yorle[/b], find what is causing the Evil Ones to appear in the village. Save the townsfolk from the oppression of the traitors and the Evil Ones. Will you be able to help infected villagers or will you have to "[i]put them out of their misery with a sharp sword or other helpful weapon[/i]"?

Over [b]20[/b] more pages are available to be added to your personalized Book Of Yorle story in the order you find them. With over [b]60[/b] pages in total, can you find them all to complete your book ([i]so far[/i])?

notes.title: New video tutorial
notes.content: We have added a video that shows new players how to use the keyboard controls throughout the game. We recommend that you watch this, but whether you do or don't, we strongly suggest that you run through the training level when you enter the game. Make sure to read the books provided (they are short) to learn about some of the features that you will encounter throughout the game. When you get into the village, be sure to check out the library for many more helpful, informative, and/or funny (depending on your sense of humor) books.

notes.title: Welcome!
notes.content:
To all potential followers of the Holy Yorle:

Welcome! It is only minutes until the release of "The Book Of Yorle: Save The Church". Our beta testers have been a tremendous help in getting the game ready for release. We wish to express our heartfelt thanks to all of them. While they haven't reported very many bugs (thank goodness), we have taken care of those issues immediately. That is our goal for any issue reported by anyone. Please let us know if an issue arises for you. We are extremely joyful at the release of our game which has been in development for approximately a year and a quarter. 

We are still finishing our multiplayer and VR modules. We hope to be able to complete those within the next couple of weeks. These will be free updates to all purchasers of the game.

We hope that you will invite your friends to explore with you as you each create your own version of "The Book Of Yorle". The pages of this book are added via your personal adventures and activities throughout the areas of the kingdom contained in the game and upcoming futures DLCs.

Our plans include the ability for you to obtain a copy of your personal "Book Of Yorle" as you have created it throughout the game. We know you have the ability to read it during the game, but this will give you something to show to your friends who may not yet be followers of the Holy Yorle.

Good luck on your adventures! Keep us posted and we'll keep you posted.

May the Holy Yorle be with you!
